title: Doesn't live up to the competition. Refills are pricey
text:
Doesn't live up to the competition. Refills are pricey. This is in our guest bathroom. It won't be used a lot in there compared to our master bathroom or kitchen which is just as well. We have the Purell foaming soap dispenser in the kitchen and compared to it, this one just doesn't measure up.

This is a manual push rather than automatic via battery power, so it can end up with a messy handle if you have lots of traffic through the bathroom. Mine came with only an adhesive attachment option - no screws included for a more permanent solution. I added my own screws, but the Purell unit had everything.

Finally, the soap refills aren't easy to find for this unit and they really aren't budget friendly. The Purell foaming soap refills aren't necessarily inexpensive either, but they are larger and more readily available. I think I will just buy another of those instead next time.
